sentence: This project builds a carbon-based anode material for lithium-ion batteries and works out how to make it at larger scale.
This project builds methods that let computers learn from people how to spot fake biometric inputs.
This project studies how a fruit fly that spreads into new areas survives winter and how its traits may change with climate change.
This project studies how water movement and mixing in fjords in Greenland affect nutrients and the food supply for fish and marine mammals.
This project builds millimeter-wave radio transmitters that use less energy by using wide-bandgap semiconductor chips and artificial intelligence to tune them.
This project studies how a group of proteins that processes messenger RNA in plants varies in its makeup between different cells and mutants.
This project builds a security framework to protect distributed energy resources, such as renewable energy systems and electric vehicles, from attacks.
This project studies how soil microbiomes affect crop yield and resilience by reconstructing microbial genomes and using machine learning.
This project uses computational methods to study how CRISPR-Cas proteins change shape and cut DNA and RNA.
This project builds Bayesian methods that analyze data after random noise has been added to protect privacy.
This project studies how a warming ocean changes the iron and copper needs of marine microbes that process ammonia and nitrite.
This project builds methods that solve nonlinear power grid equations entirely with quantum computing.
This project builds a system that detects and corrects defects in large metal parts as they are being made with laser wire directed energy deposition.
This project builds mathematical models of how mutant cells spread in the blood of mice and adapts them to humans.
This project studies how the metabolic burden of making natural products affects yeast cells and how the cells adapt.
This project designs freeform metasurfaces that create strong chiral fields so that mirror-image molecules can be sensed with high sensitivity.
This project studies the photochemical pathways that break down oxidized polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and how temperature and salinity affect them.
This project builds a splitting method that breaks hard nonlinear equations into smaller problems so simulations of inertial confinement fusion run more efficiently.
This project builds a small 3D-printed device that uses CRISPR to measure several proteins and nucleic acids in one blood test.
